transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for being here. As you know, Press 5 has been throwing intermittent servo-drive alarms over the last two production weeks, and we've got a replacement servo retrofit kit ready in the storeroom. We have the Saturday maintenance window from 06:00 to 16:00 available, and I'll be making the final call on whether we take Press 5 offline for the retrofit. Before I finalize the work order, I want to hear from each of you — controls engineering, production planning, safety, and quality — on any relevant findings or concerns. Let's go around the room.

I also want to note that several documentation items still need to be tied to the work order: Ravi's bench-test note, Monique's schedule update, Gareth's safety permit entry, and Sofia's control-plan link. Before I finalize my decision, can anyone confirm whether the 20 first-off housings and their Quality checks can be completed within the remaining Saturday window after the 8-hour retrofit, or do we need to plan for those to carry over? I want to make sure we have a realistic timeline before I authorize the work.
